items.claim: Panels sharing one channel get each other's answers, and the earlier panel hangs as connected
items.note: A `yo` and a `bye` can now carry an optional `session` id, and the page tags every message it sends with it. A panel ignores other sessions' messages. When another session's `sup` arrives, the earlier panel goes to `error`, says it was replaced, and rejects its pending requests. A `bye` naming another session closes nothing. Messages without a `session` work as before, so the protocol number stays at 1. The extension's content bridge and relay (`apps/devtools-extension`) now carry the session too. That app has no `package.json`, so it has no changeset. `docs/devtools.md` describes the new field. The devtools changeset is `minor` because the field is new API.

items.claim: `close()`/`open()` stay half-open when the transport's `send` throws
items.note: `close()` now tears down even if sending `bye` throws. If sending `yo` throws, the client goes to `error` and a later `open()` can retry.

items.note: The story now uses editing's `view`, `pick`, `move` and `shapeToolsOffered` presets with `defaultTools={['rect']}`. It is a story-only change, so it has no changeset.
